definitions.explanation: Fine granular material found on beaches, in deserts, and riverbeds. Made of tiny particles of rock and minerals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{砂浜|すなはま}→砂浜：noentry⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{砂|すな}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{熱|あつ}い→熱い：09888_atsui⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: The sand on the beach is hot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{砂|すな}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいます→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: The children are playing in the sand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{砂場|すなば}→砂場：06326_sunaba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいます→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。

examples.japanese: ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{帰|かえ}ったら→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧、⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ついた→付く：01960_tsuku⟧{砂|すな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{洗|あら}って→洗う：00827_arau⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: When you come back from the beach, please wash off the sand on your body well.

notes:
{砂|すな} refers to fine granular particles of rock, found on beaches and in deserts.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {砂浜|すなはま}: sandy beach
- {砂漠|さばく}: desert
- {砂場|すなば}: sandbox, sandpit
- {砂|すな}ぼこり: sand dust
- {流|りゅう}{砂|さ}: quicksand

EXPRESSIONS:
- {砂|すな}を{払|はら}う: to brush off sand
- {砂|すな}に{埋|う}もれる: to be buried in sand

KANJI NOTE:
The same kanji appears in {砂糖|さとう} (sugar), where it's read as さ.
